title: Brain & Spine Surgery (Neurosciences)
tagline: Advanced neurosurgical care with cutting-edge technology.
description: Park Clinic is a recognised leader in neurosciences, boasting one of the most advanced neurosurgical setups in the region.
features: Treatments & OTs: The department is equipped with 5 dedicated neurosurgical operating theatres. It was among the first in the country to utilise Intraoperative Neuronavigation and Neuroendoscopy.
Key Doctors: Experienced neurosurgeons performing high-precision procedures for brain tumours, neurovascular disorders, and paediatric neurosurgery.
Post-Operative Care: A specialized Neuro-HDU and ITU ensure 24/7 monitoring by a three-tier medical team.

title: Orthopaedics & Spine Surgery
tagline: Restorative surgeries and advanced spine care.
description: The orthopaedic department focuses on restorative surgeries and advanced spine care.
features: Treatments & OTs: Specialized in Joint Replacements (Knee and Hip), Arthroscopy, and complex trauma management.
Park Spine Centre: A dedicated wing for spondylitis, spinal deformities, and disc surgeries.
Patient Satisfaction: High success rates in spine surgeries have made it a preferred center for Kolkata Traffic Police and other professional groups.

title: Paediatrics & Childcare
tagline: Subsidised yet superior care for newborns and children.
description: Merging with the Park Children's Centre in 2009, this department provides subsidised yet superior care for newborns and children.
features: Treatments & OTs: Dedicated Pediatric Operation Theatres handle surgeries for congenital anomalies, paediatric urology, and neonatal emergencies.
Facilities: The Anubha Memorial Neonatal Ward features advanced neonatal ventilators and a specialized NICU/PICU for critical paediatric care.
Key Doctors: Dr. Subir Kr. Chatterjee (Emeritus/Consultant), Dr. Ashoke Kr. Basu

title: ENT & Maxillofacial Surgery
tagline: Comprehensive care for ear, nose, throat, and face.
description: Comprehensive care for disorders of the ear, nose, throat, and face.
features: Treatments: Micro-ear surgeries, Cochlear implants, and functional endoscopic sinus surgery (FESS).
Key Doctors: Dr. Amit Roy and Dr. Manish Mukul Ghosh (Plastic & Maxillofacial Surgery)

title: General, Uro & Laparoscopic Surgery
tagline: Minimally invasive techniques for faster recovery.
description: The hospital utilizes minimally invasive techniques to reduce post-operative pain and recovery time.
features: Treatments: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy, hernia repairs, and advanced urological procedures like TURP and kidney stone removal.
Key Doctors: Dr. Kalyan Sarkar (Urology)
